sections.h1Accent: AI Replies, Order Updates and Follow-Ups on WhatsApp

body.text: Teknoppy provides WhatsApp automation services that let businesses answer customers, confirm orders, send reminders and follow up leads on WhatsApp automatically, using the official WhatsApp Business Platform. We build AI-powered WhatsApp assistants and automated message flows that connect to your website, spreadsheets, CRM and billing tools.

paragraphs.text: In Kerala and across India, customers prefer WhatsApp over email and phone calls for most everyday questions. WhatsApp has more than two billion users worldwide, and many businesses now receive more enquiries there than anywhere else. Answering every message by hand is slow, especially after hours, and leads go cold.
WhatsApp automation services solve this by replying instantly, collecting the right details, sending updates at the right moment and passing important conversations to your team.

paragraphs.html: WhatsApp business app vs API is the first decision. The free WhatsApp Business app suits very small businesses with one phone and simple quick replies. The WhatsApp Business Platform, often called the API, supports multiple team members, AI chatbots, automated notifications, integrations with your systems and much higher message volumes.

paragraphs.text: Our WhatsApp Business API integration covers account setup through Meta, business verification, phone number registration, message template approval and connection to your chosen inbox or software.

sections.h2: Is WhatsApp Automation Allowed by Meta?

paragraphs.text: Is WhatsApp automation allowed by Meta? Yes, when you use the official WhatsApp Business Platform and follow Meta's policies. Customers must opt in to receive messages, business-initiated messages use pre-approved templates, and promotional content follows Meta's commerce and messaging rules.

WhatsApp official API vs unofficial tools: unofficial "bulk sender" tools and browser hacks break WhatsApp's terms and frequently lead to numbers being blocked. We only build on the official platform, so your number and customer trust stay protected.

sections.h2: What WhatsApp Automation Services Do We Offer?

items.title: WhatsApp Chatbot Development
items.text: WhatsApp chatbot development creates a WhatsApp AI chatbot that understands natural questions in English, Malayalam or Arabic, answers from your approved information, shares catalogue links and collects enquiry details. Customers get instant answers at any hour, and your staff only step in when needed.

items.title: WhatsApp Auto Reply for Business
items.text: A WhatsApp auto reply for business goes beyond a simple away message. It greets new contacts, offers menu options, answers common questions and routes chats to the right department based on what the customer asks.

items.title: WhatsApp Order Automation
items.text: WhatsApp order automation sends order confirmations, dispatch updates, delivery notifications and invoices automatically from your website, billing or delivery software. Customers stop calling to ask "where is my order?"

items.title: WhatsApp Payment Reminders
items.text: WhatsApp payment reminders notify customers about due invoices, fee instalments or renewals, include a secure payment link, and send a thank-you once payment is received. Collection improves without awkward phone calls.

items.title: WhatsApp Lead Follow-Up Automation
items.html: WhatsApp lead follow-up automation contacts new enquiries within seconds, asks qualifying questions and sends follow-ups if they go quiet. Leads from your website, ads and forms all receive a prompt, consistent response.

items.title: WhatsApp Broadcast Automation
items.text: WhatsApp broadcast automation sends approved updates, offers and announcements to customers who have opted in, scheduled and segmented by interest or location. Replies flow into the same inbox, so conversations continue naturally.

items.title: WhatsApp AI Agent
items.text: A WhatsApp AI agent goes one step further than a chatbot. It can check stock, look up order status, book a callback or create a support ticket by working with your other systems, within limits you set.

items.title: WhatsApp Sync With Google Sheets
items.html: WhatsApp sync with Google Sheets suits smaller teams that track leads, orders or bookings in spreadsheets. New enquiries and replies are added automatically, and sheet updates can trigger WhatsApp messages.

paragraphs.text: WhatsApp automation for small business usually starts with an auto reply, enquiry capture and a lead follow-up flow, which can be live within a week or two. WhatsApp automation for retail stores adds order updates, back-in-stock alerts, festival offers and loyalty messages. Training institutes, clinics, travel agencies and service companies use similar flows for enquiries, reminders and confirmations.

How to automate WhatsApp messages correctly comes down to four steps: register on the official WhatsApp Business Platform, get your message templates approved, connect WhatsApp to the systems that hold your data, and design flows that respect customer opt-in and Meta's rules. Our WhatsApp automation services handle each step, so you do not need to manage the technical setup yourself.

sections.h2: WhatsApp Automation Setup Time and Process
sections.intro: WhatsApp automation setup time depends mainly on Meta's verification and template approvals, which usually take a few working days.

items.title: Discovery (1 to 2 days)
items.text: We agree on goals, flows, languages and systems to connect.

items.title: Platform setup (3 to 7 days)
items.text: Business verification, number registration and template approval.

items.title: Build (1 to 3 weeks)
items.text: We build bots, flows and integrations.

items.title: Testing (2 to 4 days)
items.text: We test every flow with real examples.

items.title: Launch and support (ongoing)
items.text: We monitor delivery, replies and opt-outs, and improve flows monthly.

paragraphs.text: Typical totals: 1 to 2 weeks for auto replies and lead capture, and 3 to 5 weeks for an AI chatbot with order and payment automation.

Costs have three parts: a one-time setup and build fee, Meta's own messaging charges for certain business-initiated messages, and a monthly fee for the inbox or automation platform and AI usage. We estimate all three before you commit, so there are no surprises. Most small businesses start with one focused flow, such as enquiry capture or order updates, and add more once the first one proves its value. This keeps the first investment modest and lets you see real results, such as faster replies and fewer missed leads, before expanding to payments, broadcasts or an AI assistant.

items.q: How long does WhatsApp automation take to set up?
items.a: A basic auto reply and lead capture flow usually goes live in one to two weeks. An AI chatbot connected to orders, payments and your CRM takes three to five weeks. Meta's business verification and template approval are the main variables, and we start those on day one so the build and approvals run side by side.

items.q: Will my WhatsApp number get blocked?
items.a: Blocks usually happen when businesses use unofficial bulk tools, message people who never opted in, or send spammy content. Because we build only on the official platform, collect proper opt-in and keep message quality high, the risk is very low. We also monitor your quality rating and adjust flows if customers start blocking or reporting messages.

items.q: Can the chatbot reply in Malayalam?
items.a: Yes. The AI can understand and reply in Malayalam, English, Hindi, Arabic and mixed-language messages such as Manglish. We test common customer phrases in each language before launch, and anything the bot cannot answer confidently goes to a staff member instead of guessing.

items.q: Can my team still reply manually?
items.a: Yes. Automation handles routine questions and updates, while your staff use a shared inbox to take over any chat at any time. Several team members can work on the same number, with chats assigned by department, and the bot pauses automatically when a person joins the conversation.

items.q: Do you work with businesses outside Kerala?
items.a: Yes. We provide WhatsApp automation services to businesses across India and to international clients, with discovery, testing and training handled online. Message templates, languages and opening hours are set up for each market, so customers in different countries get replies that suit them.
